title: Replace Azure SQL defaults configuration
goal: Replace the removed Azure SQL defaults helper while preserving retry settings and database access.

selectionNotes: EF10 UseSqlServer(..., sql => sql.UseAzureSqlDefaults()) is replaced by UseAzureSql(connection). UseAzureSql already exists in EF10: adopt it before upgrading. EF11 removes the defaults helper. Both paths use six retries with a 30-second maximum delay. Preserve intentional retry and compatibility overrides; these defaults do not change the database compatibility level. Local SQL2025 compatibility170 round-trips are approved evidence for this bounded configuration migration. No Azure outage, retry scheduling, Entra authentication or cloud service parity is established.
